placements.title: Asynchronous job execution and interface contracts

placements.title: Immediate receipts decouple remember execution from extraction without lost work
placements.frame: How does the remember contract ensure caller responsiveness while guaranteeing reliable, pollable extraction processing?
placements.why: Wynn and Xena ratify an async contract where remember operations return immediate receipts and allow extraction observation via cursor polling or piggybacking, eliminating blocking calls and preventing lost work.
